name: Heraldry Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (nobility) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Powerful Contacts (Ex)

You have developed powerful contacts and know how to use their influence to open doors. Once per encounter, you can invoke the name or office of one of your powerful contacts and substitute a Knowledge (nobility) check for a Diplomacy or Intimidation check, without an increase in the time needed to make the skill check; this is a language-dependent ability.

In addition, wherever you travel, you can gain audience with a regional judge, a powerful minister, a courtier that holds the emperor’s ear, a general, an infamous crime lord, or some other significantly influential individual. This does not ensure that such an audience will prove friendly or beneficial. At the very least, however, you can use your meeting to gather information, substituting Knowledge (nobility) in place of Diplomacy.

Associated Technique
Charging Technique (Ex)

You add 1/2 your scholar level (minimum 1) as a bonus to damage on the first attack you make at the end of a charge against a target you have studied with this ability.

Advanced Study Abilities
Banner (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nobility) 5 ranks, Powerful Contacts study ability, scholar level 5th.

You gain the banner ability, as the cavalier class feature, using your ranks in Knowledge (nobility) as your effective cavalier level. If you are at least a 14th level scholar with at least 14 ranks in Knowledge (nobility), this functions as the greater banner class feature.

Faithful Aide (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Powerful Contacts study ability, scholar level 4th.

You have acquired a talented apprentice, student, bodyguard, or servant. You gain one of the following variant Leadership feats:

Groom, Light Bearer, Page, or Weapon Bearer. (You do not need to meet the usual prerequisites of whichever variant leadership feat you choose.) This functions like the Leadership feat, but it applies only to a cohort, and your Leadership score is equal to your ranks in Knowledge (nobility) + your Charisma bonus. Your cohort may advance in level no more than your ranks in Knowledge (nobility) –3. When you reach scholar level 7th and 7 ranks in Knowledge (nobility), you may swap the feat chosen for the Leadership feat.

Tactician (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (nobility) 3 ranks, Powerful Contacts study ability, scholar level 3rd.

You gain a teamwork feat of your choice.

You must meet any listed prerequisites for the feat selected. Once per day as a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to grant the use of one of your teamwork feats to all allies within 30 feet who can see and hear you. Allies retain the use of this feat for a number of rounds equal to 3 + your Charisma modifier. (Provided you meet the prerequisites of this feat, your allies do not need to.)

Special: You may select this study ability a second time once you reach 15th level and 15 ranks in Knowledge (nobility). If you do so, you gain a second teamwork feat and can use this ability twice per day, selecting which of your teamwork feats to grant each time you use it.
